title: Reading glass — 40 mm CR-39
description: The reading glass is a eyewear optic specified here at 40 mm CR-39. Axial chromatic aberration: different colors focus at different distances along the axis. Lateral chromatic aberration: colors shift sideways at the image edges. Corrected with a multi-element achromat. Typical use: theater viewing.

aberration_notes: Axial chromatic aberration: different colors focus at different distances along the axis.
Lateral chromatic aberration: colors shift sideways at the image edges.
